answer_1.quote: Great progress has been made in natural language generation (NLG) with pre-trained language models in recent years. Lyrics generation is also a special task of NLG.

answer_2.quote: We use three kinds of objective evaluation metrics: general level, low level, and high level...

answer_4.quote: We invite 43 annotators to evaluate the generated lyrics. Each annotator is required to score lyrics concerning four aspects.
answer_4.guideline: Each aspect is rated with an opinion score from 1 to 5 (from bad to excellent). The four aspects are as follows: 1) Coherence: the overall consistency of the topic of the entire song; 2) Fluency: the fluency of the semantic correlation within a sentence and between the sentence; 3) Correlation: the structural or semantic similarity among sentences; 4) Fascination: the degree of fascinating sentences in annotators' opinion.
